text:
jun (eng-platform): thinking out loud — we need a clear "undo" / audit-first flow for automatic fallback rollouts. current console shows "enable fallback" but no easy rewind. ideas?

mira (product): +1. biggest ask from a few PMs is being able to 'stop and inspect' after fallback triggers before it affects user traffic again.

kevin (eng-runtime): two parts: 1) a UI action to 'pause fallback' that prevents new fallback activations; 2) an immediate audit entry + snapshot of routing config at trigger time. the snapshot needs KV cache state id.

lia (eng-sre): we also need a safe escape-hatch button that doesn't fully revert config (which can be dangerous) but switches to read-only mode and routes low-risk traffic for testing. call it 'quarantine mode' maybe. :thinking_face:

jun (eng-platform): quarantine mode sounds good. UX options: 
- single-click "Pause and Quarantine" (blocks new fallbacks, marks rollout paused)
- "Revert route" (full rollback)
- "Create incident checkpoint" (captures logs + traces)
Which should be primary?

samir (eng-platform): primary should be "Pause and Quarantine". reverts are invasive and usually require coordination. default action should be the least destructive.

mira (product): agree. rename to "Pause fallback + Snapshot"? PMs liked explicit "Snapshot" language.

kevin (eng-runtime): technical note: snapshot needs the following payload recorded in audit: 
```
{
  "rollout_id": "r-12345",
  "policy_state": "fallback_triggered",
  "model_variant": "gptq-6b-q4",
  "routing_snapshot": { "routes": ["primary","fallback"], "weights": [0.8,0.2] },
  "kv_cache_id": "kv-2024-11-07-8f3e",
  "active_quota_buckets": ["team:payments","org:acme"],
  "trigger_reason": "500-error-rate>0.05"
}
```
This must be immutable and downloadable.

lia (eng-sre): also include a short, human-readable "why" string and a pointer to top 3 traces/requests by latency/error. Helps blameless triage.

jun (eng-platform): telemetry side: we should bake in a small event stream for every fallback lifecycle change: TRIGGERED, PAUSED, SNAPSHOT_TAKEN, REVERTED, UNPAUSED. that lets dashboards show rollback frequency per model.

mira (product): dashboard mock: show a timeline strip under each rollout with markers for TRIGGER/PAUSE/REVERT and an "undo window" countdown (e.g., 15m). if snapshot exists we show a download link.

samir (eng-platform): question — how long should the undo window last? default 15m sounds reasonable but ops might want 24h for slow issues. make it configurable per rollout.

kevin (eng-runtime): config option + guardrail: if snapshot size > X MB or contains PII, require extra confirmation and redact sensitive fields before export. we also must integrate with KMS for KV id snapshots.

lia (eng-sre): can we include a CLI flow? something like: 
```
redwood rollback --rollout r-12345 --mode quarantine --reason "high cpu" --snapshot-download ./snap.json
```
should trigger the same audit events as the console.

ops-bot: noted. created support ticket #INC-8122 for adding 'Pause+Snapshot' endpoint.

jun (eng-platform): UX detail: wording is important. "Undo" implies magic revert. prefer "Pause fallback" and separate "Revert to primary". show both but emphasize pause.

mira (product): +1. also add a tiny confirmation modal that summarizes impact: traffic diverted, quotas rebalanced, expected latency delta.

kevin (eng-runtime): API sketch for pause endpoint: 
```
PATCH /api/v1/rollouts/r-12345/policy
{ "action": "pause_fallback", "reason": "investigating spike", "snapshot": true }
```
response includes audit_id and snapshot_url.

samir (eng-platform): we should also add a boolean "auto-unpause": false by default. allow timed auto-unpause with required SLA check.

lia (eng-sre): telemetry: add fallout metric for "paused_by_human" vs "paused_by_system". helps separate flappy infra from deliberate ops.

jun (eng-platform): next steps: samir/kevin to prototype API + audit record shape, mira to mock modal copy, lia to list required traces/logs to attach. i'll draft console copy for confirmation modal.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: eng-platform/fallback-ux -> staging at 2024-11-08T03:00Z :rocket:

mira (product): thanks — ping when staging has the modal so PMs can validate language. :thumbsup:

jun (eng-platform): cool. I'll create the PR today with the audit schema and example event stream.

samir (eng-platform): tagging followups: #design for modal comps, #sre for logs list, #security for snapshot redaction rules.

lia (eng-sre): one more: make sure snapshots are retained per retention policy and surfaced in the Rollouts UI audit tab.

jun (eng-platform): noted. closing loop here. will add tiny thread summary to the rollout docs after PR lands. :white_check_mark:
